pro_course_detail.title: Casual Conversation Practice

If you do not have time for homework, we will talk about your life, goals, interests, current events, or anything you like 🙂 I will prepare a set of discussion questions based on a theme for our lesson (e.g. shopping, movies, news, ethical dilemmas, travel, holidays...)

If you have time for homework, I will send you an article or video that will serve as a primary topic of discussion!

pro_course_detail.title: Reading, Writing & Discussion
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson will include plenty of conversation practice and discussion, but I will also ask you to complete a reading and written homework assignment for us to go over during class time. 
An example lesson: I will send you an article for homework about how work culture has changed over time in the United States. Then I will ask you to complete some comprehension questions and write a short essay (1-3 paragraphs) describing work culture in your home country and how you believe it differs from U.S. work culture. We will discuss the topic, look at difficult or confusing passages from the article, and then I will provide feedback and correct any errors in your essay!

pro_course_detail.description: Do you have an interview or presentation coming up? Let's start by going over the most common questions that are asked in any kind of interview and how to nail them! We can work on public speaking skills, word choice, minimizing filler words, and body language.

pro_course_detail.description:
It is no secret that one of the best ways to improve foreign language skills is to read in them as much as possible. In fact, our knowledge of languages can perhaps best be measured in the kilometers of text we’ve read in them!

Literature provides access to a treasure trove of language, which we can use to enrich our own speech, writing and understanding. It provides the absolute best examples of careful and precise language usage, from which we can learn more than any English textbook.

At the same time, reading in a foreign language allows us to discover and explore new worlds. But instead of traveling through space, we travel through text! Reading is, perhaps, the best way to deepen our understanding of other cultures. The universe of literature written in English or translated into this language is boundless, and your journey though it can provide lifelong enjoyment!  

As a teacher of literature, I can help you make reading in English interesting and fun!

Before the lesson you will read a short story, essay, poem, or extract of a longer text in English. The text will never be too long, and will be chosen in accordance with your skill level. If you want to read a whole novel, please tell me, and we will make a study plan.
